small_business_appetite: Gerber Life Guaranteed Life whole life. Issue ages 50–80. Face amounts $5,000–$25,000 ($15,000 max in South Dakota). No health questions on the application — guaranteed acceptance subject to the two-year graded death benefit. Contracted via AMG. Agent portal: www.gerberlifeagency.com. Fax apps to 877-608-4634.
products_available: Guaranteed Life whole life (policy form ICC12-GWLP / GWLP-12; NY GWLP-19-NY)
territorial_restrictions: Issued in all states except MT. SD face max $15,000. State requirements vary.

small_business_appetite: Guarantee to accept ages 50–80 is made possible by a two-year graded death benefit. Year 1–2 non-accidental death: return of premiums + 10% of earned premium. Accidental death in graded period: full face amount. After two years: full face for any cause. Suicide within two years (one year in ND): premiums + 10% earned premium only. Agents MUST disclose the graded benefit to all applicants.

Monthly ACH premiums (checking/savings) preferred — ACH discount up to ~8%. Direct bill / Direct Express / debit / credit card monthly premiums are higher than ACH. Additional rates on the Gerber Life Agent Portal quote tool. Modal factor example: Monthly = Annual Rate × 0.090909.

Producer Certification page is part of the Guaranteed Life app and must be submitted with the application. App asks NO health questions. Required/conditional forms: CA senior disclosure (age 65+ home visit — keep on file, do not send); NY Definition of Replacement (required even though replacements not allowed in NY — same sign date as app); state Replacement Form if replacing; NAIC Replacement Sales/Marketing Materials Form (commissions withheld until received); Payment Authorization (ACH-AP); Receipt CRGI for check/money order. Kansas cannot accept check/money order with application. Split commissions allowed between 2 agents. Applications faxed to 877-608-4634. No POA/guardianship apps except legal guardians of children.
Replacements are NOT accepted in: CA, DE, FL, ID, IL, KY, MA, MO, NY, PA, PR, TN, WA.
territorial_restrictions: No replacements: CA, DE, FL, ID, IL, KY, MA, MO, NY, PA, PR, TN, WA
